opening: I am applying for the Praktikant:in als LLM /RAG & Machine Learning Engineer position at U-Glow GmbH. My Python, RAG and API project experience provides a foundation for building agent-based features that connect reliable AI behaviour with product workflows and existing backend services.
blocks: In my MVP UPSC project, I architected an end-to-end intelligent assistant utilizing LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (embeddings, similarity indexing), and Agentic AI workflows for automated evaluation and deep synthesis. I implemented multi-agent reasoning, semantic search over complex syllabi/documents, and production-grade REST APIs. I would use this project experience to test retrieval quality, examine responses against source material and document application limitations before relying on generated outputs in product workflows.

In my Kidney Disease Classification project, I implemented a full MLOps pipeline with MLflow for experiment tracking, DVC for data versioning, and Flask REST API for model serving, deployed via CI/CD on AWS.
interest: For these product workflows, I would agree expected outputs and failure cases with product and engineering teams. For developing LLM applications and retrieval workflows, I would agree the expected outputs and review criteria with the team before making changes. I would compare results with source information, record unresolved questions and make the reasoning behind proposed changes clear to the colleagues reviewing the work. I would use feedback from the people relying on these outputs to decide which improvements need attention first and how to verify their effect.
title: Praktikant:in als LLM /RAG & Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d)

responsibilities.responsibility: developing LLM applications and retrieval workflows
